findings.text: the invariant segment set is encoded twice in the file and nothing binds the two: PATTERN_INVARIANT_SEGMENTS (families.py:411) is what pattern_signature consumes, while _PATTERN_FAMILY_MEMBERS_QUERY (families.py:438) and _PATTERN_FAMILY_CENSUS_QUERY (families.py:469) hard-code the same four columns (coalesce on physical_base, geometric_base, transformation, process). Adding or renaming an invariant segment to the tuple leaves both live queries grouping on the old tuple and no test reddens, because the fixture re-implements the grouping in Python (see the durability justification).

the fixture _PatternGraph.query dispatches on the query text (a HAS_PARENT substring returns []) and re-computes membership with the module's own pattern_signature, so the landed change's Cypher WHERE clauses are never executed by any test. The negative control catches only a whole-route swap; a mutation of an equality clause inside _PATTERN_FAMILY_MEMBERS_QUERY (for example dropping coalesce(m.geometric_base,'') = geometric_base) leaves all 16 tests green while the live graph would return a different family.

parent_name is the seed's physical_base value and is returned verbatim as parent.name (context.py:913) even when no StandardName carries that id; fetch_family_base then returns {} and the family is handed to the docs prompt (workers.py:_enrich_for_docs_gen) with a base-quantity name that may not exist and an empty description. The old HAS_PARENT route always named a real parent node; docs_accepted is False in this case so it defers rather than asserts, but the name is still rendered.

assemble_family now returns grouping pattern (harmonize.py:343), but build_worklist(include_parentless=True) still groups parentless names by physical_base and emits grouping physical_base with a physical_base key (harmonize.py:472-524), so the module carries two parentless-family definitions and the plan's one-definition-of-a-family statement is only partly satisfied. The brief scoped the retirement to assemble_family, so this is recorded rather than repaired here.

the Sibling Families headline count and the gate that decides whether to call build_worklist run an inline HAS_PARENT query (operator_kind IN projection/qualifier/coordinate/locus), so the harmonize command's family count still reports the pre-change definition and disagrees with the pattern family the docs prompt and assemble_family now use. cli/sn.py is outside this node's write scope (the brief forbids editing the caller), so the divergence is recorded for the coordinator.
row_pattern_signature is defined (families.py:499) and referenced nowhere in the repository, dead code added with the change.
